questions.prompt: What is the source identifier for the Juju Terraform provider?
questions.explanation: The provider is published as juju/juju on the Terraform Registry.

questions.prompt: Which authentication method uses an empty provider block and reads Juju CLI config?
To reference a model from a juju_application, you must use:
questions.explanation: Applications reference models by the computed uuid attribute.

questions.prompt: The Juju Terraform provider supports deploying bundles directly.
questions.explanation: The provider deploys charms individually; use Terraform modules to emulate bundles.

questions.prompt: Which provider argument targets a specific controller by address instead of the current one?
questions.explanation: controller_addresses lets you specify which controller to connect to.
